name: VanTran Transformers
old_description: Custom distribution-class transformer manufacturer headquartered and manufacturing in Waco, Texas, now part of the Forgent power infrastructure group.
about:
VanTran Transformers was founded in 1963 in Vandalia, Illinois, and relocated to Waco, Texas in 1974, where it remains headquartered and operates its manufacturing facility. The company is now part of the Forgent power infrastructure group, which combines VanTran with MGM Transformers, States Manufacturing, and PwrQ to deliver end-to-end power solutions.

VanTran designs and manufactures custom distribution-class transformers, including padmount, substation, multi-tap substation, auto-transformers, submersible and vault, grounding, polemount, and dry medium-voltage units (VPI and cast resin). Its capabilities span custom engineering, retrofit design solutions, and in-house manufacturing, supported by a workforce of 51 to 200 employees.

The company serves industrial, oil and gas, petrochemical, utility, data center, rental power, renewable energy, mining, and transit markets. Customers include data centers, manufacturing facilities, and power-grid operators requiring short delivery cycles and on-time delivery for critical infrastructure projects.

VanTran emphasizes timely, customizable, liquid-filled distribution transformers with what it describes as the shortest lead times in the industry. The firm has been recognized on the Inc. 5000 list of fastest-growing U.S. companies, citing exponential growth that enables expanded client support while maintaining high-quality standards.
